articles.title: Critical Package Registry Attack Targets AI Toolchains
articles.summaryKo: A coordinated package registry attack targeted developer environments that install AI tooling.
articles.whyItMattersKo: AI development stacks often combine fast-moving packages, credentials, and automation, which raises the blast radius of supply chain attacks.

articles.title: OpenAI Releases Agent Evaluation Toolkit
articles.summaryKo: OpenAI introduced a toolkit for evaluating agent behavior in multi-step workflows.
articles.whyItMattersKo: Agent evaluation is becoming a practical requirement as teams move from demos to production workflows.

articles.title: New Research Maps Failure Modes in Graph RAG Systems
articles.summaryKo: Researchers categorized common failure modes in Graph RAG systems and proposed evaluation criteria.
articles.whyItMattersKo: Understanding graph retrieval failures helps teams design relationship-aware insight features with better evidence quality.

articles.title: PostgreSQL Adds Native Vector Index Improvements
articles.summaryKo: A PostgreSQL release improved vector index performance for retrieval-heavy workloads.
articles.whyItMattersKo: Better vector indexing makes it easier to build search and RAG features without adding infrastructure too early.

articles.title: Kubernetes Project Updates Long-Term Support Policy
articles.summaryKo: The Kubernetes project updated its support policy for production operators managing long-lived clusters.
articles.whyItMattersKo: Support windows shape upgrade planning, security posture, and operational cost for infrastructure teams.
